name: reverseplugin
description: Native PE analysis, process memory, and debugging tools exposed through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Native PE analysis and Windows debugging over MCP.
interface.longDescription: A native C++23 MCP server for static PE analysis, structured Zydis disassembly, function and cross-reference discovery, persistent annotations, validated process-memory access, stack walking, and Win32 debugging. Ten focused skills provide engine and runtime analysis workflows without coupling domain knowledge to the native server.
defaultPrompt: Open a PE binary and build a structured analysis plan.
Inspect a Windows process without modifying it.
